claims: Amy Madigan won the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress for her role as Aunt Gladys in Weapons at the 98th Academy Awards in March 2026.
Amy Madigan's win marks her first win.
Amy Madigan's only previous nomination was for Best Supporting Actress for Twice in a Lifetime (1985) at the 1986 ceremony.
Amy Madigan was a nominee for Best Supporting Actress for Twice in a Lifetime at the 58th Academy Awards.
Amy Madigan won Best Supporting Actress for Weapons at the 98th Academy Awards.
Her 40-year gap between nominations from 1986 to 2026 set a new record for the longest gap for an actress.
The Guardian reported on her win in March 2026.
